Printed edition: The sacred theory of the earth. Containing an account of the original of the earth, and of all the general changes which it hath already undergone, or is to undergo, till the consummation of all things. In four books. ... With a review of the theory, ... As also the author's defence of the work, ... And an ode to the author by Mr. Addison.  1753: Vol 2, 1753, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/bim_eighteenth-century_the-sacred-theory-of-the_burnet-thomas_1753_2.
